design_source: Study/Study 01 New/数据/E09_六方法共同测试/实验配置.json
n50: extension of the same deterministic generator and namespace; new samples
cw_solver: profile shape equation + log-gap sign scan (97 points) + Brent root; first root from sample minimum; explicit residual check; not original Fortran
wmle_protocol: existing production five-start solver; only on rejection reuse E09 profile_recover (513 points); unchanged weights and acceptance constraints
metrics: shared standard metrics; normalized beta/true beta, eta/true eta, gamma/true eta; joint J1=root mean sum squared normalized errors; failures receive joint squared score 3 as E09, reported separately
scope: complete independent samples, positive lifetime observations; no censoring, contamination, other MMLE variants or Kundu-Raqab MMLE
